svg.text: 18 couplings across 9 domains · 20 plugins · 27 CLI commands · 11 SPEC documents · commit a45436f · companion report: drift-risk-map.md

g.text: The pattern: this repository verifies what it generates, and does not verify what it copies.
Every CRITICAL finding is a hand-transcription whose "source of truth" a comment declares and no test enforces.
Three of the four are consistent today — which is exactly why they are dangerous.

svg.text: Each spoke is one coupling, placed on the ring of its risk tier. Arrows point toward the source of truth. Inner ring = unguarded and silent.
Eight couplings whose propagation mode is silent. All eight are hand-transcriptions.

svg.text: Ordered by priority. Every one of these runs inside the existing CI test job — no workflow change needed.

g.text: Directory-driven test recomputing sha256 for all 9 plugins — the check acme_* already runs, generalised. Track _ingest_bin/ so the declared source exists in CI. Closes #1 and #5.

Render in memory, compare to the committed docs/specs/*.md, exit non-zero on difference — the contract build-arch-census and build-profile-atlas already implement. Glob-enrol in doc-drift.test.ts. Closes #3.
Have plugins re-export from the tracked static/schemas/ original, making tsc the guard. Where non-null assertions block it, compare normalised token streams. Closes #2.
~40 lines extracting the probe, tier, defect and Pass-6 tables and asserting set-equality against PROBE, SOURCE_TIER, DEFECT_KIND and RULE ∪ KC_UNENFORCEABLE_CHECKS. Closes #4.
Replace the 7-phrase allow-list with a projection over every registered command, applied to MANUAL.md, README.md and AGENTS.md, with a commented opt-out array. Closes #6, #7 and #8.

svg.text: This diagram was produced by static heuristic analysis. No finding should be taken as ground truth. Validate all CRITICAL and HIGH findings manually before acting on them. Four findings were verified by execution — see the Methodology section of drift-risk-map.md.
